# External sources

Reference/upstream source trees used during Lagi development.

- **Azel** — primary reconstructed PDS runtime and source-level behavior reference.
- **ATOLM** — matching decompilation/accuracy reference.
- **pds-tools** — PDS asset/format documentation and tooling.

The Azel submodule is currently pinned at:

```text
c52329fb257561abff05531a8335e34137d67098
```

Lagi-specific Vita adaptations should normally remain in the Lagi repository so the upstream reference stays easy to compare against.

Do not copy copyrighted Panzer Dragoon Saga game data here.
